## Experience review

For changes to an interface, editorial experience or media output, apply the [pinned portfolio review](https://github.com/Starlight-Intelligence/starlight-design-intelligence/blob/35c96d7fb4a75d879a92756e03ab5018228eea27/evals/frontier-experience-review.md) alongside the owning product checks.

- [ ] Link the user task, exact candidate, before/after evidence and exercised interaction or playback, including the accessible alternative.
- [ ] Link scoped identity, rights and source decisions for affected assets using an authorized evidence location.
- [ ] Record the independent verdict, unresolved failures and publication scope.
